candidate.title: Single-Cell-Derived Tumor Organoid (STO) arrays on a microfluidic chip for personalized drug screening to address heterogeneity-induced drug resistance in colorectal cancer
candidate.abstract: Tumor heterogeneity drives chemotherapy resistance in cancer, necessitating the development of strategies to target diverse cellular subpopulations. Single-cell-derived tumor organoids (STOs), derived from individual tumor stem cells (TSCs), retain well-defined genomic and phenotypic attributes, making them instrumental in elucidating unique diversification. Here, we developed a microfluidic approach that utilizes STO arrays for personalized drug screening, aimed at overcoming heterogeneity induced drug resistance in colorectal cancer. We utilized a microwell array format microfluidic chip to the generation of a high scale STO array. This array encompasses two key features: (1) STOs in individual microwells are derived from single TSCs, which allows for a high-resolution display of cellular heterogeneity; (2) it exhibits thousands of STOs at predefined locations on the same focal plane, thereby facilitating automated, high-content analyses using imaging data. Utilizing the STO array, we assess the responses of various subpopulations of colorectal cancer to a conventional chemotherapeutic regimen, facilitating the phenotypic identification of resistant STOs. Through the analysis of RNA sequencing data from the resistant STOs, candidate drugs targeting resistance-associated pathways were identified for individual patients. Furthermore, the candidate drugs were validated through STO-array drug testing, demonstrating enhanced clearance effects when combined with the conventional regimen. Our study establishes a scalable, patient-specific drug screening approach that integrates phenotypic and molecular analyses, offering a transformative strategy to overcome heterogeneity-driven drug resistance in colorectal cancer. The microfluidic platform presented herein holds significant potential for advancing precision oncology and personalized therapeutic design.
candidate.authors: Dongguo Lin, Yanzhang Luo, Jueming Chen, Ziqing Ma, H. Kang, Xiaogang Wang, Lihui Wang, Da-Yu Liu

extraction.method: 微流控单细胞阵列+STO药物筛选+转录组
extraction.data: CRC患者单细胞来源STO阵列；高通量成像与测序
extraction.scenario: 个性化药筛与异质性耐药
extraction.benchmark: 与多细胞来源类器官MTO比较；耐药STO与敏感STO对比

extraction.summary: 作者开发微流控STO阵列用于结直肠癌个性化药筛以应对异质性耐药。用亲水涂层微孔阵列随机捕获单细胞，藻酸-壳聚糖膜包裹原位培养数千STO，并进行药物测试和转录组分析。发现STO保留肿瘤表型与遗传特征，可识别耐药亚群及潜在靶点，候选药物经STO阵列验证有效。
